name: thryft-media-export
description: Nitro HybridObject module for on-device video/image composition + export. Consumes the Thryft composition document and an ExportIntent; produces a local file (mp4/png) with real progress and cancellation. iOS: AVFoundation (AVMutableComposition + AVVideoComposition + AVAssetExportSession). Android: Media3 Transformer (1.10.x) + Effects + Composition.setHdrMode.
